article.title: Chapter not to apply where transfer of immovable property made after a certain date.
article.content:
269RRChapter not to apply where transfer of immovable property made after a certain date.

Section 269RR  ·  Chapter XX-A  ·  page 931 of the Act
The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to or in relation to the transfer of any immovable property made after the 30th day of September, 1986.
